Project passport gives 0.064 km for low-voltage line column (whose heading itself says КЛ0,4); ВОР p56 says ВЛИ-0,38 total59m. Do not infer equality or use either as actual installed length.
Specification and passport wire79m; ВОР p56 line wire67m and p57 ВРЩ lead11,5m. Keep section-specific quantities; no arithmetic repair of rounded/specification totals.
Plain extraction glues quantity and mass: шт.7900 means visible quantity7 and mass900, NOT quantity7900. м791,24 means79m and1,24kg mass; never parse as791,24m.
PS-2-1 construction6pcs vs grounding3pcs; NC20 construction3pcs vs grounding15pcs; F207 construction15m vs grounding15m. Preserve separate section/position and do not silently aggregate.
Сталь круглая d8, ГОСТ2590-2006 is the PDF identity. Do not change it to Арматура based on an XLSX sheet caption.
